checks: npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.app.json 2>&1 | grep education-journey | head; echo tsc-done
prompt:
Write src/data/education-journey.ts exporting `educationJourney: Journey` (family: 'education') for the EDUCATION & WORK family of the Atlas of Education site: credentials, schooling and labour markets. Models in scope (all must get cards): the China youth-unemployment fitted labour-market model (fitted + free residual; Aug-2021 step unexplained; naive benchmark beats it out of sample), the Cambodia household child-labour/schooling simulation (calibrated out-of-school rates + illustrative cost index; 5 of 13 levers smaller than seed noise), credential dynamics / credential floor (illustrative; graded vs hard liquidity constraint; premium counterfactual now same-year 2035, older values historical), and the four massification stored experiments (parents & peers, three actors, unequal access, persistence). Use the existing family-stories education section as the starting narrative. Suggested chapters: why credentials and work; China youth unemployment; Cambodia child work and schooling; the credential floor; massification experiments; what would settle it.
FORMAT: follow src/data/angkor-journey.ts exactly (types, house style) and src/data/shadow-journey.ts (a second example). Start with `import type { Journey } from './angkor-journey'` and export the named const. repo: 'https://github.com/TreyModels/atlas-of-education'. NO `interactive` field. Claim types: 'published' only for peer-reviewed studies; 'data' for official statistics/surveys; 'sim' for Atlas simulation results; 'open' for unsettled; 'method' for how it works.
DONE MEANS: (1) open with a plain-language question and why it matters to someone with no background; (2) chapters follow observations/literature -> proposed mechanisms -> rules/assumptions -> experiments -> findings -> limits; every chapter has evidence, rule, result, limitation; (3) EVERY actual model in this family (see the catalogue entries in src/data/model-catalogue.ts for this family) gets a model card with purpose and state; distinguish models from download bundles and duplicate interfaces (bundles are not separate models; mention them as links); (4) "implementation checked" is not empirical validation; a historical run is not a current fit; name evaluation data and window where applicable; (5) maths in words first, optional formula/symbols/worked example; (6) each card links code or research files that exist: relative links must be paths under public/ that appear in the context (e.g. research/..., reference/..., engines/...); otherwise use absolute https GitHub URLs under https://github.com/TreyModels/atlas-of-education/tree/main/... ; card `route` = the catalogue id/route when the catalogue shows it as an internal or route entry.
RULES: every number must come from the context files; never invent numbers, sources, quotes or findings. No "proves"/"ruled out". Candid about development state. bottomLine 2-3 sentences. Return only the one file.
